searchText: I'm thinking that we'll spend next week's standup as an opportunity for cohort one participants to ask questions to those in cohort zero. Excellent. Thanks ! Are eth2 topics valid areas of explorations? yes, did you have anything specific in mind? Can contributing to ZKSync be part of the apprenticeship program? No, I don't have anything specific in mind. Hi man. What is the most effective way to contribute for or during the merge process ? Understanding a consensus client ? Or going into the rabbit hole for sharding and/or roll ups ? Beacon ? Sorry if what I just said is not applicable to my question, but the most important point is to read you (and anybody else please feel free). Thanks ! Yes This type of generic "shotgun" offer to help with no specificicity typically won't get you anywhere. Do your due diligence. Read up on what's been written. Join public calls. Gain some understanding and keep your eyes open for things that look like you could help with Testing re merge. We're currently working on creating static test cases, mock implementations, fuzzing, etc. If you're interested in that you can dm me. Am on holiday until monday though In an e-mail it says that it would be a good idea to introduce myself here, but I do not see other people intros. Should we introduce here or is there other channel? You can use <#595701895700676644> for introducing youself and what you are working through as well if it's for the program specifically, send your intro here! Thanks. Understood ! ok, whatever you say 🤣 . I will send mine later Emails have just been sent to all cohort-one applicants with the results of the selection process. If you don't have something in your inbox (or spam folder) within the next hour or so reach out to me directly so we can figure out what went wrong. when the cohort-one begins? seems that already had some meetings There is no specific start date. Some people have already begun. Others will start in the coming weeks. Is there going to be some kind of team formation process or work is going to be individual? Self organizing if you want to team up with anyone but we won't be "teaming people up" just got the email. Thanks for the consideration <@!364458974906548225>. I didnt make it. I wish luck to all the candidates. I plan to lurk around here and gain from everyones experience will look for an opportunity to pitch in. I didnt Make It too | But Wanna Learn From Here And Gain Some Experience From Everybody worth reminding that anyone is welcome to still participate, create a project without being "accepted" we'll be here giving feedback / suggestions on whoever is here regardless! Anyone who is interested in diving into ZK related things should DM me with their telegram handle. I have a group chat I can add you to that has some of the ZK researchers in it. Don't expect them to teach you things, but they can definitely answer questions if you take the time to do your homework and ask them a good question.
